retrieval_method: Official upstream Git tag resolved and checked out; action and implementation source inspected. Date recorded at UTC day precision.
inspected_contracts: init accepts one matrix language, build-mode none, tools linked, queries and debug inputs
init returns codeql-version; workflow rejects any version other than 2.27.0
setup-codeql.ts prioritizes defaults.json when tools linked is supplied
init setup-python-dependencies input is deprecated and ignored; action does not install Python dependencies
analyze upload accepts always, failure-only or never; database upload is a separate input
analyze requires built-in GitHub token and security-events write for SARIF upload
analyze supports upload-database false and wait-for-processing true
limitations: Manifest records inspected upstream interfaces, not a completed security scan
CLI release assets are obtained by the pinned upstream action; this manifest does not pin their archive digest
No CodeQL CLI or query execution was performed locally
Repository enablement, Code Scanning availability and rulesets remain owner configuration inputs
